name: OD Commander
description: OD Commander is a two-pane file manager designed for gamepad control, included in Batocera so files can be managed without a keyboard. It is a fork of DinguxCommander, which was written for handheld Linux devices running Dingux and OpenDingux. Batocera lists it as a system you launch like a game.
curiosities: It descends from DinguxCommander, a file manager for Linux handhelds such as the Dingoo A320.
It uses a two-pane layout in the style of Norton Commander.
In Batocera it has been available on all platforms since version 34.
